title: Define workforce categories beyond licensed professionals
requirements:
- Define the registry as covering roles, qualifications, registrations, licences and other recognised authorisations
- Make registration number and licence fields conditional on regulated status so CHWs and unlicensed cadres can be recorded
- Include cadres without formal licensing and model their recognition types
- Provide configurable inclusion criteria for unlicensed, informal, trainee, volunteer, foreign-trained and other cadres
- Support provisional and pending-verification statuses
- State when a record is created and how identifiers are assigned to workers not requiring licensure
- Support multiple linked identifiers and flexible human-name models
- Allow attribute requirements to vary by occupation and extend governance to non-regulated cadres
